written.headline: US approved Chinese firms with empty offices to handle Nvidia chips
written.summary: The US Commerce Department approved dozens of Chinese companies to handle Nvidia's H200 chips, including some with empty offices and ties to firms under sanctions. An investigation revealed a pattern of companies connected to entities with national-security-related trade restrictions being approved.

written.headline: AI investment cycle may have peaked, Jefferies warns
written.summary: A report by Jefferies warns that the global artificial intelligence investment cycle may have peaked or entered a mid-cycle correction due to rising financing costs and profitability concerns. The four major hyperscalers increased combined capital expenditure by 108 per cent year-on-year to USD 202 billion in the third quarter of 2026.

written.headline: Qualcomm targets AI-native 6G commercial rollout in 2029–2030
written.summary: Qualcomm announced plans for an AI-native 6G commercial rollout targeting 2029–2030 and teamed up with SpaceX to help build Starlink's new national cellular network. The company's 6G approach integrates artificial intelligence directly into the network architecture to manage connections, resources, and radio-spectrum allocation.

written.headline: Ocient raises $100m Series C to expand agentic AI analytics platform
written.summary: Chicago-based data analytics company Ocient raised a $100 million Series C funding round co-led by Boka Capital and OCA Ventures, bringing its total funding to $260 million. The capital will expand delivery of its agentic AI analytics platform for petabyte-scale data environments.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick says LLMs can accelerate investigative reporting
written.summary: Ethan Mollick stated on Bluesky that large language models can accelerate investigative research into companies and governments. He noted that analyzing filings and public data previously required a team of journalists a long time.
